question_text: A foreign investor wants to acquire a 10-hectare agricultural land in the Philippines for a resort development. Under Article XII of the 1987 Constitution, which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: The foreign investor may acquire the land because it is for tourism development, which is a priority sector.
The foreign investor may acquire the land if he partners with a Filipino citizen who owns at least 60% of the enterprise.
The foreign investor cannot acquire the land because only Filipino citizens or corporations with at least 60% Filipino ownership may own land in the Philippines.
The foreign investor may acquire the land if he secures a special permit from the Department of Environment and Natural Resources.
